Welcome to the official YouTube channel of the North Carolina Zoo!  

At the North Carolina Zoo, our guests connect with wildlife from two different continents as they explore exotic animal habitats, exciting attractions and hundreds of educational experiences.  Located at the foot of the picturesque Uwharrie Mountains, the Zoo is just outside Asheboro, NC.

Guests can discover more than 1,600 animals and 52,000 plants throughout our 500-acre conservation park.
